title: agrostis alba var. pallens
intro: Agrostis alba var. pallens, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis alba var. pallens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
